thriller.en: Genre — thriller: sustain tension and forward momentum; keep the reader uncertain about what comes next. Favor short propulsive beats, concrete stakes, and a ticking sense of danger.

hurt_comfort.en: Genre — hurt/comfort: center emotional vulnerability and care. Move between pain (physical or emotional) and the relief of being comforted; prioritize tenderness, aftercare, and earned intimacy.

crack.en: Genre — crack: lean into absurd, comedic, self-aware chaos. Escalate ridiculous premises with confident internal logic; prioritize humor over realism while keeping characters recognizable.

fix_it.en: Genre — fix-it: rewrite events so a prior tragedy or bad outcome is averted or repaired. Give characters the agency and second chances they were denied; steer toward healing and better endings.

psychological.en: Genre — psychological: foreground interiority, unreliable perception, and the slow pressure of the mind. Favor mood, ambiguity, and the gap between what characters feel and what is real.
